inputs.policy: Assess only closure of the CVE-2026-109618 alert for the named synthetic website at the stated review snapshot. Accept closure only when evidence binds that exact asset to its hosting platform/tier, an applicable remediation, and a current observation of the PHP runtime serving that website that meets the provider verification guidance. A general rollout announcement, CLI version, or WAF statement alone is not site-specific patch proof. An old displayed version can still qualify when an applicable backport is demonstrated by the provider-prescribed serving-runtime check. If asset, tier or runtime proof is missing, the closure claim is unproven; do not infer vulnerability or compromise from missing evidence. Other CVEs and general PHP safety are outside this policy.
